tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khon sku 'bum gyi gtsug lag khang nyams gso gsar skrun bgyis pa'i yi ge/ oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /thub dbang rgyal tshab dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /skyes chen rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /gdan sa 'di nyid 'debs par mdzad pa po/ 1 /'khon ston dkon mchog rgyal po zhes grags pa'i/ /skyes chen de yi sku gdung rin po che/ /hril por bzhugs pa'i mchod rten ngo mtshar la/ /kun du khyab pa'i rin chen gser chab dang / 2 /bzhugs gzhan gtsug lag khang gi nyams gso sogs/ /bcas nas logs rnams kun la dus mchod pa'i/ /gdung brgyud rim par byon pa'i brgyud rim dang / 3 /gzhan yang bstan la bka' drin che ba yi/ /bla ma'i sku brnyan 'dod lha chos skyong bcas/ /bzhugs pa'i gnas la sa rgyan mchod tshogs dang / /gnam rgyan bya spu la sogs/ khyad gos tshogs 'ba' zhig las grub/ 4 /mthong ba tsam gyis kyang 'gro ba kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog byed 'di/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /rang lo re gnyis lon pa'i khyi yi lo/ 5 /bka' drin mnyam med dkon mchog rgyal po sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs phyir du/ /nyams pa gsar bzhengs lta bu'i zhabs tog 'dis/ /mtshon pa'i dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ 6 /bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i shes rgyud sgrib byang nas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /bstan pa rgyas shing tshe 'di 'phos ma thag /bar do med par dpon slob dag pa'i zhing / 7 /mngon dga' bde ba can dang mkha' spyod sogs/ /smon lamadabang gis gegs med legs 'dzoms nas/ /sa lam mthar phyin gang 'dul sprul pa yis/ /bstan pa spyi dang bye brag sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa rin chen rgyun 'di dbyar mtsho ltar/ /phyogs dus kun tu 'phel zhing rgyas gyur nas/ /bdag cag mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba rnams/

/kun kyang dag pa'i zhing du 'dren gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ 'khon sku 'bum gyi gtsug lag khang nyams gso gsar bskrun bgyis pa'i yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
